title: Frontend capability architecture
scope: One user-visible capability and its frontend implementation boundary

nodes.name: Frontend capability
nodes.responsibility: Owns the route, interaction state, presentation, and recovery behavior for one capability
nodes.source: replace with source code or accepted architecture decision

nodes.name: Business API
nodes.responsibility: Owns authoritative business data and writes behind a versioned contract

relationships.label: uses to complete the accepted outcome

pages: Capability page with one primary user outcome

states.loading: Preserve orientation and show bounded progress
states.empty: Explain why no business data exists and offer the next valid action
states.error: State the impact and provide a recoverable action without losing user input
states.unavailable: Keep authoritative state unchanged and offer retry or a deterministic fallback
states.ready: Expose one clear primary action and current business status

interactions.result: Validate locally, call one versioned contract, and render the resulting authoritative state

interactions.trigger: The provider returns an error or is unavailable
interactions.result: Preserve user work, explain impact, and expose a safe retry or fallback

data_contracts.read_write: The API owns authoritative writes; the frontend owns only transient interaction state

quality: Keyboard and screen-reader operable for the critical journey
Responsive behavior defined for compact and wide layouts
Loading and input response targets tied to the accepted user outcome
No duplicate side effects after retry or navigation

elements.title: Capability page
elements.details: Owns the route, page-level states, focus order, and recovery path

elements.title: Route shell
elements.details: Provides navigation context and a stable slot without owning feature state

elements.title: Primary workspace
elements.details: Renders the accepted task, validates input, and emits explicit user intents

elements.title: Status and recovery
elements.details: Makes loading, empty, error, unavailable, and ready states observable and actionable

elements.title: Interaction controller
elements.details: Owns transient UI state and maps explicit user intents to versioned requests

elements.title: capability.api.v1 adapter
elements.details: Isolates transport details, validates responses, and exposes typed failure states

feedback.message: Replace template requirement IDs, sources, contracts, and targets with approved project evidence before acceptance.
